Court of Québec
Small Claims Division

Exemple Nord Construction Inc.
1199999006
Sept-Îles (Québec)

October 7, 2026

Subject: Notice of garnishment - case 2026-7744112

A garnishment order has been issued against your company in the matter of Mercier v. 9185-2204 Québec Inc.

Case: 2026-7744112
Amount to be withheld: $3,200.00 CAD
The garnishment takes effect on October 19, 2026.

As garnishee, you must withhold funds from any amount you owe to the debtor. This order does not concern one of your employees. It names a company whose money you may be holding.

Court of Québec
